title: Shorten
desc: Trims long text down to a set number of words without cutting mid-thought — handy when a reply runs long. Category: Text & Words. Version: 1.0. Functions: shorten(text, maxWords), firstSentence(text).

title: Count
desc: Counts words, characters and sentences, and estimates reading time — the quick health check for any text. Category: Text & Words. Version: 1.0. Functions: count(text) -> {chars, words, sentences, readingMinutes}.

title: Clean
desc: Tidies messy text: collapses extra spaces, strips invisible control characters, and can turn any title into a URL slug. Category: Text & Words. Version: 1.0. Functions: clean(text), slugify(text).

title: Keywords
desc: Pulls the most important words out of any text by frequency — a quick way to see what a passage is about. Category: Text & Words. Version: 1.0. Functions: keywords(text, n).

title: Summarize
desc: Boils text down to its first few sentences — a fast, honest extractive summary with no guessing. Category: Text & Words. Version: 1.0. Functions: summarize(text, n).

title: Template Fill
desc: Fills {{placeholders}} in a template with real values — the easy way to build prompts and messages. Category: Text & Words. Version: 1.0. Functions: fill(template, vars).

title: Diff Words
desc: Compares two texts word by word and lists what was added and what was removed. Category: Text & Words. Version: 1.0. Functions: diffWords(a, b) -> {added, removed}.

title: Wrap
desc: Wraps text to a set line width without breaking words — for clean pre-formatted output. Category: Text & Words. Version: 1.0. Functions: wrap(text, width).

title: Tone Shift
desc: Expands contractions (don't → do not) to make casual writing more formal — a small, real tone adjustment. Category: Text & Words. Version: 1.0. Functions: expandContractions(text).

title: Bullets
desc: Turns lines into bullet points and back — for tidy lists in chats and pages. Category: Text & Words. Version: 1.0. Functions: toBullets(text), fromBullets(text).

title: Step Thinker
desc: Breaks any goal into numbered steps and can frame a question so the Llama thinks step by step. Category: Thinking & Reasoning. Version: 1.0. Functions: steps(goal, n), thinkPrompt(question).

title: Pros & Cons
desc: Splits marked-up lines into pro and con lists, and gives you a blank decision frame to fill in. Category: Thinking & Reasoning. Version: 1.0. Functions: split(text) -> {pros, cons}, frame(topic).

title: Decider
desc: Scores options against weighted criteria and ranks them — decisions with the math shown. Category: Thinking & Reasoning. Version: 1.0. Functions: score(options).

title: Five Whys
desc: Generates the classic five-whys chain to dig to the root cause of anything. Category: Thinking & Reasoning. Version: 1.0. Functions: fiveWhys(statement).

title: Socratic Questions
desc: Asks the five questions that test whether an idea actually holds up. Category: Thinking & Reasoning. Version: 1.0. Functions: questions(topic).

title: Fermi Estimator
desc: Frames a Fermi estimate: break a huge question into guessable factors and multiply. Category: Thinking & Reasoning. Version: 1.0. Functions: breakdown(question, factors).

title: Invert
desc: Flips a goal upside down — plan how to fail at it, then simply avoid each failure. Category: Thinking & Reasoning. Version: 1.0. Functions: invert(goal).

title: Analogy
desc: Builds an analogy frame: what maps across between two things, and what breaks. Category: Thinking & Reasoning. Version: 1.0. Functions: frame(a, b).

title: Find Assumptions
desc: Pulls assumption phrases (assume, if, suppose, given that…) out of any text so you can check them. Category: Thinking & Reasoning. Version: 1.0. Functions: find(text).

title: Checklist
desc: Makes a check-off list from any goal and tracks what is done. Category: Thinking & Reasoning. Version: 1.0. Functions: make(goal, items), check(list, i).

title: Notes
desc: Remembers things for you in the browser — save a note under a key, recall it later, forget it when done. Category: Memory. Version: 1.0. Functions: set(key, value), get(key), forget(key).

title: Fact Store
desc: Collects facts about any topic into a list you can read back any time. Category: Memory. Version: 1.0. Functions: add(topic, fact), about(topic), clear(topic).

title: Pin Board
desc: Pins important items to a board so they stay at the top of the Llama's mind. Category: Memory. Version: 1.0. Functions: pin(item), pinned(), unpin(i).

title: Timeline
desc: Keeps a dated timeline of events — add what happened and when, read it back in order. Category: Memory. Version: 1.0. Functions: add(when, what), all().
